 News › News News › JEE Main 2027 FAQs released: Check NTA answers on Aadhaar mismatch, DigiLocker, APAAR ID and registr… JEE Main 2027 FAQs released: Check NTA answers on Aadhaar mismatch, DigiLocker, APAAR ID and registration
 Sajid Raza Updated: Nov 16, 2026, 15:48 IST ​JEE Main 2027 FAQs released The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for candidates applying for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session 1. The FAQs cover some frequently asked questions about the online registration process, identity verification and eligibility.
 Candidates are advised to check the official clarification to clear their doubts before filling the JEE Main 2027 application form.
 In the JEE Main 2027 FAQs, the NTA has clarified about several issues like the requirement for the APAAR ID, the information given on the Aadhaar card, mismatch between class 10 certificate and the Aadhaar card, and the DigiLocker e-KYC and guidelines for Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) and Non-Resident Indian (NRI) candidates.
 Last Date of JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Registration: November 22, 2026. The candidates appearing for the engineering entrance examination should follow the application procedure before the specified period. They are also advised to carefully read the official FAQs and Information Bulletin to avoid mistakes while filling out the application form.
 JEE Main 2027 FAQs: Important clarifications by NTA 
 The NTA has addressed several questions that candidates may encounter during JEE Main 2027 registration. 
 The important questions and their answers are provided below.
 1. How can OCI candidates register for JEE Main 2027? 
 The JEE Main 2027 Application Form is available to both domestic and overseas candidates. Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) can also apply for JEE Main 2027 by checking Option 2 that is designed for Foreign Nationals (including OCI) candidates. Candidates are required to give information about their genuine non-Indian passport as ID proof during the online application process.
 OCI candidates are advised to read the instructions given in JEE Main 2027 Information Bulletin while filling the application form.
 2. Is the Class 12 registration or enrolment number mandatory for JEE Main 2027? 
 No, appearing candidates in their class 12 examination in 2026-27 are not required to fill the JEE Main 2027 application form with their class 12 registration number, enrolment number or roll number.
 Candidates who do not have these details will be able to choose ‘Not available' in the application form and continue with application.
 3. How can NRI candidates apply for JEE Main 2027 without an Aadhaar card, PAN card or APAAR ID? 
 For those who are non-resident Indian (NRI) but do not have an Aadhaar card or APAAR ID, but hold a valid Indian passport, there is a specific 'NRI (Having No Aadhaar)' option on the JEE Main registration page.
 The eligible candidates are allowed to opt for this and can follow the instructions given by NTA to fill the application form.
 4. Will a name mismatch between the Class 10 marksheet and Aadhaar card affect JEE Main 2027 candidature? 
 No, if there is any mismatch between the candidate's name on the Class 10-mark sheet and Aadhaar card it will not impact on the candidature of the candidate.
 The NTA has given candidates instructions to enter their names in the JEE Main 2027 application form as provided on their 10th class certificate or marksheet. Candidates are requested to make sure the name mentioned in the application form matches their class 10 academic record.
 5. How will NTA verify the UDID card details of PwD/PwBD candidates? 
 The information of Unique Disability ID (UDID) card uploaded on the time of registration will be checked from Unique Disability ID (UDID) web portal of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DePwD) for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).
 Candidates not having a UDID card need to upload the Disability Certificate in prescribed format. NTA can confirm the certificate that was uploaded directly with the issuing authority.
 For more information candidates are referred to Paragraph 3 of the note under Step 2 in the Application Procedure of JEE Main 2027 Information Bulletin.
 JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration deadline: November 22 
 The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application form will close on 22nd November 2026. 
 Candidates who have not registered their application yet must do so before the time.
 Eligible candidates are able to access the official website (jeemain.nta.nic.in) and use the online application form to register for JEE Main 2027.
 Before starting the application process, candidates should keep their required documents and identity details ready. They need to also look for the information that is entered in the registration form to ensure that there are no errors when submitting the registration form.
 The candidates are hereby informed to read the JEE Main 2027 FAQs and Information Bulletin from the official website to know about the registration information, identification verification and other instructions.
